NFLOW = max(FD.values()) + 1
G0 = 32.174  # ft/s^2


def make_flow(W, P, T, h, S=0.0):
    a = np.zeros(NFLOW)
    a[FD['W']] = W
    a[FD['P']] = P
    a[FD['T']] = T
    a[FD['h']] = h
    a[FD['S']] = S
    return a


class ThrustCalc(om.ExplicitComponent):
    """Net thrust from nozzle exit (static) flow and freestream conditions."""

    def setup(self):
        self.add_input('flow_stat', shape=NFLOW)
        self.add_input('W0', val=100.)       # lbm/s
        self.add_input('V0', val=0.)         # ft/s
        self.add_input('Pamb', val=14.696)   # psia
        self.add_output('Fn', val=10000.)    # lbf
        self.add_output('Wexit', val=100.)
        self.add_output('Vexit', val=1.)

    def compute(self, inputs, outputs):
        f = inputs['flow_stat']
        W = f[FD['W']]
        V = f[FD['V']]
        Ps = f[FD['Ps']]
        rho = f[FD['rho']]
        A = W / (rho * V) if (rho > 0 and V > 0) else 0.0
        gross = W * V / G0 + (Ps - inputs['Pamb']) * A
        ram = inputs['W0'] * inputs['V0'] / G0
        outputs['Fn'] = gross - ram
        outputs['Wexit'] = W
        outputs['Vexit'] = V
